item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 05/Mar/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the northeast monsoon and its associated broad band of clouds, temperatures over the coast of southern China will fall progressively and there will be a few rain patches in the next couple of days. The weather will be rather cool over the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of this week. It will be cold over inland areas. The monsoon is expected to be replaced by an easterly airstream early next week. Temperatures will rise gradually and it will be brighter over the region. A humid maritime airstream will affect the coastal areas midweek next week.

Weather: Mainly cloudy with one or two rain patches. Fog patches at first.

R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium Low
